chapter.heading: Let All Things Praise the Lord
chapter.v:
Praisethe Lord!Praise
God in His sanctuary;Praise Him in His mighty firmament! [2 Kin. 24:1; 2 Chr. 36:5-7; Jer. 25:1, 3; 45:1; Dan. 1:1]

Praise Him
for His mighty acts;Praise Him according to His excellent greatness! [Is. 8:1; Ezek. 2:9; Zech. 5:1 c Jer. 30:2; Hab. 2:2 d Jer. 25:15 e Jer. 25:3]

Praise Him
with the sound of the trumpet;Praise Him with the lute and harp! [Jer. 26:3; Ezek. 12:3 g [Deut. 30:2, 8;]

Praise Him
with the timbrel and dance;Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes! [Lev. 16:29; 23:27- 32; Acts 27:9] [Jer. 32:12 i Jer.]

Praise Him
with loud cymbals;Praise Him with clashing cymbals!

Let everything
that has breath praise the Lord.Praise the Lord!
